midnight-navy.$description: Midnight Navy — Violet text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

flame-orange.$description: Flame Orange — Filled CTA buttons, icon strokes, decorative accents — the single chromatic action color that commands every screen it touches

wine-burgundy.$description: Wine Burgundy — Secondary section background, hero display text, promotional bands — adds warmth and depth against the navy

deep-ink.$description: Deep Ink — Outlined/ghost button borders, dark text on light surfaces, deep button variant background

abyss-navy.$description: Abyss Navy — Pressed/secondary button fill — a near-black navy for dark button variants on the navy canvas

powder-blue.$description: Powder Blue — Card surfaces and light-blue panel backgrounds within dark sections — breaks up the navy with breathing room

warm-cream.$description: Warm Cream — Hero left-panel background, soft warm neutral — used in only the highest-impact first-screen block

snow-white.$description: Snow White — Primary text on dark surfaces, button borders, input fills, card text — the dominant foreground color

graphite.$description: Graphite — Heavy-use border and text color on light sections, structural dividers

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Badge and pill borders on light surfaces

fog.$description: Fog — Subtle dividers, muted panel backgrounds

stone.$description: Stone — Input field borders, low-priority form chrome

dsc-specter.$description: Primary display and body family — condensed heavy sans with extreme weight range, used uppercase for navigation, product names, CTAs, and section headers; weights 700-900 drive display headlines (32-52px) while 400 handles body and small UI.

gelica.$description: Secondary utility family for navigation, fine print, and body micro-copy — a serif counterpoint to Specter's industrial weight.

gtstandard-m.$description: GTStandard-M — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

font-awesome-5-pro.$description: Font Awesome 5 Pro — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
